Attempting hitchhiking in Morocco with no plan. Is it actually possible to get around Marrakech this way?

I decided to embrace my favorite style of travel today: the total unknown. My hotel staff thought I was crazy, but I wanted to see if I could make it work. This Marrakech vlog documents the reality of trying to get around without a clear plan.
